go get rsc.io/fortune/v2

# The default executable name shouldn't be v2$GKEXE
go build rsc.io/fortune/v2
! exists v2$GKEXE
exists fortune$GKEXE

# The default test binary name shouldn't be v2.test$GKEXE
go test -c rsc.io/fortune/v2
! exists v2.test$GKEXE
exists fortune.test$GKEXE

-- go.mod --
module scratch
